lua: T = require('lib.testkit'); CAM = require('lib.camera'); IN_VAN = function(x, z, h) local v = nova.named('van'); v:teleport(x, z, h); local s = nova.scene_now(); s.mode = 'van'; v.driven = true; v.engine_on = true; nova.named('postmaster').seated = true; CAM.reset(h) end; AT = function(ex, ey, ez, tx, ty, tz, fov) CAM.pinned = { ex, nova.terrain_height(ex, ez) + ey, ez, tx, nova.terrain_height(tx, tz) + ty, tz, fov or 50 } end; TREES = function() local n = 0 for _, o in ipairs(nova.scene_data('valley').objects) do if o.kind:match('^pine') or o.kind:match('^larch') or o.kind == 'birch' then n = n + 1 end end return n end; MASSES = function() local n = 0 for _, o in ipairs(nova.scene_data('valley').objects) do if o.kind:match('^forest') then n = n + 1 end end return n end
